items.question: Mila ___ me that she was homesick.
items.hint: There is a person after the gap (*me*): **tell** + person.

items.question: Diego ___ that the game had started.
items.hint: There is no person after the gap: use **say**.

items.question: Aisha said ___ me that she was busy.
Mrs Moreno told ___ that dinner was ready.
Which sentence is correct?
options: Tyler said me that he was late.
Tyler told me that he was late.
Tyler told that he was late.
items.answer: Tyler told me that he was late.
items.hint: *tell* always needs a person. *say* never has a person directly after it.

items.question: Sofia says that she ___ tired.
items.hint: Look at the reporting verb: *says* is in the **present** – so there is **no backshift**.

items.question: Which word can you leave out? – *Tyler said that he was hungry.*
items.hint: One word is optional in reported statements.

items.question: My host mum ___ to me that I could stay up late.
items.hint: Look at the word after the gap: **to** me.

items.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: Sofia told to Mila that the bus was late.
Sofia told Mila that the bus was late.
Sofia said Mila that the bus was late.
items.answer: Sofia told Mila that the bus was late.

items.question: Mr Okafor ___ the class that the school trip was cancelled.
items.hint: *the class* is the person (the people) you talk to.
